Selection to the post of Veterinary Officer will be made through an Objective Type (Multiple Choice) written examination
based on which a merit/proficiency list will be prepared. The exam consists of three papers.
The total marks for the written examination are 800. A negative marking of one-fourth (1/4) of the marks allotted to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer
and for multiple answers marked to a single question. No marks are deducted for unattempted questions. Use of calculators or any calculation device is not permitted in the exam hall.
The written examination will be conducted at exam centres in Haridwar and Haldwani; if the number of candidates is low
the exam may be held only at Haridwar centres.
how_to_apply: Visit the official UKPSC website, psc.uk.gov.in or ukpsc.net.in.
Go to the "How to Apply" link on the menu bar, review the Advertisement Details, Important Dates, and Instructions, then click "Apply Now."
Complete the Registration Form with accurate details and create a password, then submit to generate your login credentials.
Log in and fill in Educational Details (High School, Intermediate, Graduate, and other qualifications).
Upload photograph and signature as per the specified format and size.
Review all entered details carefully, tick the declaration, and click "Proceed."
Pay the applicable application fee via Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI using the "Pay Now" button.
Click "Print Application" to download and save a copy of the submitted application form for future reference.
important_instructions: Candidates should not wait until the last date to apply and are advised to submit the online application well in advance. All applicable category/sub-category claims for reservation must be marked in the online application form; reservation benefits will not be given if not claimed. Candidates must possess the required educational and reservation-related certificates by the last date of application submission. After final submission, candidates can make corrections only once, during the specified Edit/Correction window (22 September 2026 to 1 October 2026), except for mobile number and email ID, which cannot be edited after registration. Admit cards will not be sent by post; they must be downloaded from the official UKPSC website using registration number and date of birth. Candidates found using unfair means or submitting false information/certificates will be debarred from UKPSC examinations for up to 5 years, in addition to potential criminal action. Mere issuance of an admit card does not confirm final selection; candidature remains provisional at all stages until document verification is complete. Only the date of birth mentioned in the High School certificate will be considered valid. For technical issues during the application process, candidates can contact the helpline email: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: UKPSC has announced a total of 25 vacancies for the post of Veterinary Officer, comprising 20 posts under General Recruitment and 5 posts under Special Recruitment (Backlog). The number of vacancies may increase or decrease as per the notification. Category-wise distribution is given below. In addition to the vertical reservation shown above, horizontal reservation is applicable as per Uttarakhand Government norms: Uttarakhand Women – 30%, Ex-servicemen – 5%, Skilled Sportspersons of Uttarakhand – 4%, Dependents of Freedom Fighters – 2%, Uttarakhand Orphan Children – 5%, Uttarakhand State Movement Affected/Agitators or their dependents – 10%, and Divyang (PwD) – 4%. Horizontal reservation benefit is available only to permanent residents of Uttarakhand who stake a claim for the relevant category/sub-category in the online application.

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the educational qualification, age, nationality, and other eligibility conditions specified in the official notification to be considered for the UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026, as assessed on the last date of online application (14 September 2026). A Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc & A.H.) from a university established by law and recognized by the Veterinary Council of India, OR an equivalent degree from a government-recognized institution, OR any other veterinary qualification as defined under Section 2(f) of the Indian Veterinary Council Act, 1984 (as amended). The candidate must be duly registered with the Uttarakhand Veterinary Council. The date for determining the essential educational qualification will be based solely on the Marksheet Issuing Date or the Result Declaration Date. A postgraduate degree, diploma, or higher qualification in Veterinary Science (e.g., M.V.Sc in Surgery, Gynecology, Medicine, Pathology, Public Health, etc.), OR Minimum two years of service in the Territorial Army, OR 'B' or 'C' certificate of the National Cadet Corps (NCC). A citizen of India, OR A Tibetan refugee who came to India before 1 January 1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, OR A person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or certain East African countries with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to an eligibility certificate).

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 42 years The reckoning date for age calculation is 1 July 2026. Candidates must be born between 2 July 1984 and 1 July 2005 (not born after 1 July 2005 and not before 2 July 1984). To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

rows.relaxation: Up to 5 years, based on service period rendered

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates for the post of Veterinary Officer will be placed in Pay Level-10, with a pay scale of ₹56,100 to ₹1,77,500 per month, in addition to admissible allowances as per Uttarakhand Government norms. The post is classified as Group 'B', Gazetted, Temporary, and Contributory Pension in nature.

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates must pay the application fee online through Net Banking, Debit Card, Credit Card, or UPI. The category-wise fee structure is given below. The application fee, once paid, is non-refundable under any circumstances. Fee submitted after the prescribed last date (14 September 2026) will not be accepted, and the application will be treated as rejected.

content_sections.heading: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection to the post of Veterinary Officer will be made through an Objective Type (Multiple Choice) written examination, based on which a merit/proficiency list will be prepared. The exam consists of three papers. The total marks for the written examination are 800. A negative marking of one-fourth (1/4) of the marks allotted to a question will be deducted for each wrong answer, and for multiple answers marked to a single question. No marks are deducted for unattempted questions. Use of calculators or any calculation device is not permitted in the exam hall. The written examination will be conducted at exam centres in Haridwar and Haldwani; if the number of candidates is low, the exam may be held only at Haridwar centres.

faq.question: Q1. What is UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by the Uttarakhand Public Service Commission, under Advertisement No. A-2/DR(VO)/S-1/2026, to fill 25 Veterinary Officer posts under the Animal Husbandry Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 25 vacancies are available - 20 under General Recruitment and 5 under Special Recruitment (Backlog), subject to increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and pay the application fee is 14 September 2026 (11:59:59 PM).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry (B.V.Sc & A.H.) or an equivalent recognized qualification, and must be registered with the Uttarakhand Veterinary Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 21 and 42 years of age as on 1 July 2026, with age relaxation applicable as per category.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹166.36 for UR/OBC/EWS candidates, ₹76.36 for SC/ST candidates, ₹16.36 for PwD candidates, and no fee for orphan children of Uttarakhand.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through psc.uk.gov.in or ukpsc.net.in by registering, filling in educational details, uploading photo and signature, and paying the application fee.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UKPSC Veterinary Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an Objective Type written examination consisting of three papers (General Studies & Hindi, Veterinary Science, and Animal Science) totaling 800 marks, with negative marking.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for UKPSC Veterinary Officer?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive pay as per Pay Level-10 (₹56,100 – ₹1,77,500 per month).

faq.question: Q10. Is there a correction window in the UKPSC Veterinary Officer online application?
faq.answer: Yes, corrections/edits to the submitted application can be made only once, between 22 September 2026 and 1 October 2026 (11:59:59 PM).
